opportunities.title: Roblox Trading Automation Backend Integration
opportunities.description: # Hiring Experienced Roblox Automation Developer – Adopt Me Trading Bot System I'm looking for an experienced developer to build a Roblox Adopt Me trading bot system and integrate it with my existing website. (Please note that i am already aware of the risks and im completely fine with it and take full responsibility) The website is already built using Node.js and SQLite. I'm not looking for someone to create a new website. I specifically need someone who can develop the bot infrastructure and connect it to my existing backend. ### Project Requirements 1. Automated Trading System I need a system that can manage multiple Roblox accounts assigned to different roles: - Deposit bots: Handle incoming pet deposits and report verified transactions to my backend. - Withdrawal bots: Handle pet withdrawals based on requests submitted through my website. - Middleman bots: Coordinate trades between users where required. The system should manage trade requests, track transaction statuses and prevent duplicate transactions. 2. Pet Recognition and Trade Verification I need a reliable way to identify pets offered in Adopt Me trades, including: - Pet names and quantities. - Neon and Mega Neon variations. - Fly and Ride variations. - Combinations such as NFR and MFR. - Changes to the items offered during a trade. I'm open to using Python, OpenCV, machine learning or another suitable technology. The developer should explain how recognition accuracy will be tested and how successful trades can be independently verified. 3. Roblox Client Automation I'm looking for a developer who can propose a technically feasible approach for interacting with Roblox and handling trades. The developer should explain what tools would be required, whether the solution can run on cloud-hosted infrastructure. 4. Backend Integration My existing backend uses Node.js and SQLite. The bot system should communicate with it using REST APIs and WebSockets. It should support real-time trade updates, bot status monitoring, inventory management and transaction logging. 5. Multiple Bot Management Initially, I'm considering running approximately 5–10 bots simultaneously, with the ability to scale further. I need an admin dashboard that allows me to: - Register and remove bots. - Assign deposit, withdrawal or middleman roles. - Monitor bot availability. - View recorded inventories. - Replace unavailable bot accounts. - Review failed or incomplete transactions. 6. Hosting and Reliability The system should be designed to operate on cloud-hosted infrastructure without requiring my personal computer to remain switched on. It should include connection monitoring, automatic recovery from network failures, appropriate rate limiting and safeguards against duplicate trade processing. The developer should also explain how the system handles disconnected users, interrupted trades and unavailable inventory. ### Preferred Technologies - Node.js - SQLite - Socket.IO / WebSockets - Python - OpenCV - Roblox Luau, where supported - Cloud hosting I'm open to other technologies if they're more appropriate. ### What I'm Looking For Ideally, you should have experience with Roblox development, automation systems, computer vision, backend integration and real-time applications. Before development begins, I'd like to discuss the proposed architecture, technical feasibility and estimated development time Please include the following in your application: 1. Your previous experience with Roblox or similar automation projects. 2. Your proposed approach to trade recognition and interaction. 3. Whether you've built comparable systems before. 4. Your estimated development timeline. I'm looking for someone who can build a reliable, maintainable system that integrates with my existing website rather than starting the entire project from scratch.

opportunities.title: Custom Knight Online Bot Needed
opportunities.description: I run a private Knight Online server and I’m looking for a developer who can build a KOXP-style automation tool tailored to my environment. The bot has to grind mobs on its own, fire off the right skills in rotation, scoop up every drop, sort the inventory, sell the junk to the closest NPC, then teleport or walk to the next spot and even finish the repeatable quests along the way—completely hands-free. Stability and stealth are critical; the bot needs to hook cleanly into the KO client, read game memory without triggering common anti-cheat tools, and keep latency to a minimum so that movement and skill timings look human. A small overlay or other clear interface where I can toggle features, set skill priorities, edit farming routes, and configure quest loops will make testing and daily use easier. You should already know your way around Knight Online packets, offsets, and encryption, whether you prefer C++, C#, or another language that lets you inject or external-read safely. I’m open to your architectural choices as long as the final build is uncomplicated to launch on Windows and future offsets can be updated quickly. Deliverables that will let me sign off: • A compiled bot that runs on the current client of my private server, with automatic hunting, farming/looting/selling, and teleport + quest completion all verified in-game. • A clean configuration method (GUI overlay, INI, or similar) so I can tweak skills, items, and paths without touching code. • Documentation and commented source or update instructions so future patches don’t break the tool. If you’ve written KO bots before, show me a short clip or executable demo and we’ll move ahead right away.

opportunities.description: Saya mencari seseorang yang bisa menjadi teman ngobrol santai setiap hari melalui chat teks. Fokus utamanya adalah mendengarkan dengan empati sambil membuat obrolan terasa ringan dan nyaman. Ruang lingkup: • Hadir setiap hari (senin-minggu), minimal sekali sesi chat ±30 menit—fleksibel di sore atau malam hari. • Topik obrolan mencakup kegiatan sehari-hari, hobi, serta perasaan, stres, dan masalah pribadi yang mungkin saya alami. • Memberi dukungan emosional dasar dan perspektif positif; bukan terapi profesional, cukup seperti sahabat daring yang siap menanggapi dengan hangat. • Balasan cepat saat sesi (≤ 5–10 menit) supaya alur ngobrol tetap hidup. • Komunikasi sepenuhnya lewat platform chat teks pilihan kita bersama (WhatsApp, Telegram, atau Discord). Zona waktu dan ketersediaan harian. 3. Gaya komunikasi yang biasa Anda pakai agar saya tahu kecocokannya. Saya menantikan partner curhat yang bisa membuat hari-hari terasa lebih ringan.

opportunities.title: WordPress Event Registration Integration
opportunities.description: I’m setting up an event on my WordPress site and need the full registration flow put in place. Scope of work – Build or configure the WordPress form and map it to Stripe Checkout. WordPress, Brevo & Stripe – flow process for events that is repeatable in the future and can be moved to a new website in the near future 1. Project Objective Build one complete, working event registration, payment, with email communication system using the existing WordPress website, Brevo account, and Stripe account integration. The system must support a repeatable setup to be used for independent events while only changing the event details each time. The client will provide all email content and event-specific information. The freelancer is responsible for building the flow with technical configuration, integration, automation logic, basic testing, and written documentation to sign off. The automation is to come from the existing aspects of Registration form, Brevo and Stripe Basic Concept of flow Brevo Flow = Registration form on wordpress event page>submit will add to an event list and main list>sends email of registration to client and admin >takes client to stripe payment link> On payment > adds client to secondary list of paid and if they do not pay to an Unpaid relevant to the event name and list 2 Days prior to the event email goes to unpaid list as a reminder for payment > if they pay the persons registration gets added to the paid list 8 hours prior to the event > email with event details gets sent to paid list Anyone registering and pays after this window gets added to the main list and the paid list and gets the event details via email People can register and pay up to the end of the event Email to be sent post event manual timing for the recordings. – Connect the successful payment webhook to Brevo so the confirmation email fires instantly. – Style the email template inside Brevo to match my existing brand colors and add a calendar-add link – Test the entire flow end-to-end in both Stripe test mode and live mode, fixing any field mapping or formatting issues you notice. – Hand over clear instructions (or a short Loom) showing me how to update prices, dates, or email copy in the future. Acceptance criteria 1. A new user can register, pay, and receive the confirmation email without manual intervention. 2. All captured data appears in both WordPress form entries and the Brevo contact record. 3. No duplicate or missing records after multiple test submissions. 4. Visual styling matches the current site on desktop and mobile. Webpage is ready, the email content will be provided. Please quote based on your expectation of payment from this listing. If something needs to be added can be discussed. Thanks for your attention to this !

opportunities.title: n8n AI Multi-Channel Support
opportunities.description: I need a set of n8n workflows that tap into both Claude and Gemini so our customers receive instant, high-quality answers over email as well as WhatsApp or social media DMs. The flow should detect the incoming channel, choose the most relevant model, and return a concise, helpful reply. When confidence is low, the agent must seamlessly request additional details from the customer rather than escalating to a human. Key deliverables • Production-ready n8n workflow file(s) with clear naming and comments • Secure API integrations for Claude and Gemini, including any prompt-engineering needed for reliable answers • Channel connectors configured for IMAP/SMTP (email) and the chosen WhatsApp/social messaging API, with graceful error handling • Fallback logic that auto-asks follow-up questions when confidence drops below an agreed threshold Acceptance criteria 1. I can import the workflow into a fresh n8n instance, add my credentials, and run it without edits. 2. Test messages on each channel receive model answers that reference the original question accurately at least 90 % of the time. 3. Low-confidence scenarios trigger the follow-up request rather than a blank or incorrect answer. If you’ve built multi-model agents or complex n8n automations before, let’s get this running.

opportunities.title: Diseño Taza Sublimación PASTOR
opportunities.description: Necesito un arte listo para sublimar en una taza de 11 oz que combine elegancia y mensaje cristiano. El concepto gira en torno al acróstico “PASTOR”, dispuesto verticalmente con letras protagonistas y los siguientes textos completos: P: Predicador fiel de la Palabra A: Acompañante en todo tiempo S: Servidor con un corazón humilde T: Testigo del amor de Cristo O: Orientador con sabiduría R: Reflejo del buen Pastor, nuestro Señor Jesucristo Quiero un estilo claramente elegante y religioso: tonos sobrios (por ejemplo, beige, marfil, dorado tenue o azul profundo), tipografía serif refinada y una cruz discreta que refuerce el carácter sagrado sin recargar. A un costado debe ir una Biblia abierta bañada por una luz suave; al otro costado, el acróstico. La distribución debe sentirse equilibrada cuando la taza se gire entre ambas zonas de impresión. Entrego la pieza a imprenta, así que necesito: • Archivo final vectorial (AI, PDF o SVG) y PNG 300 DPI a tamaño real (aprox. 21 × 9 cm). • Colores en CMYK, listas para sublimación. • Una vista mock-up de la taza para aprobar el resultado. Acepto sugerencias de paleta dentro de la línea sobria descrita, pero manteniendo la cruz y la Biblia como elementos centrales. La fraseología no se debe modificar; corrige solo tildes o puntuación mínima si fuese necesario. Si puedes entregar el arte impecable y listo para producción, empecemos hoy mismo.

opportunities.title: Meta Ads y Catálogo Sincronizado
opportunities.description: Quiero dejar todo mi ecosistema de Meta funcionando sin fisuras. La prioridad inmediata es que las campañas de anuncios en Meta queden bien configuradas y empiecen a correr con un objetivo claro de aumentar visitas y reconocimiento de marca. Trabajo con Tiendanube y necesito que el catálogo de la tienda se mantenga perfectamente sincronizado con Facebook e Instagram para que los anuncios din ámicos siempre muestren inventario actualizado. Esto es lo que espero: • Vincular y depurar Business Manager, Business Suite y Commerce Manager, asegurando que la cuenta publicitaria, la página de Facebook y el perfil de Instagram estén conectados entre sí y con la tienda. • Enlazar el catálogo de Tiendanube y activar feeds automáticos para que cualquier cambio de precio, stock o descripción se refleje al instante. • Diseñar la estructura inicial de campañas (conciencia y tráfico) segmentadas para Facebook, Instagram y, cuando corresponda, remarketing web, empleando las mejores prácticas de Meta Ads. • Configurar píxel y Conversion API de forma correcta, verificando eventos clave para analizar rendimiento. • Entregarme un pequeño instructivo con los pasos principales, nomenclatura usada y cómo pausar o escalar anuncios según resultados. Busco a alguien que domine Meta Ads, se mueva con soltura en Business Suite y ya haya conectado catálogos de Tiendanube u otras plataformas. Si dominas este flujo y puedes mostrarme casos similares, estaré encantado de colaborar contigo.

opportunities.title: Diseñador Gráfico para Folleto/Brochure de Laboratorio Dental Digital
opportunities.description: Se busca un diseñador gráfico con experiencia para crear un folleto o brochure profesional y de alta calidad para un laboratorio dental digital. El material estará dirigido a odontólogos y clínicas dentales, con el objetivo de presentar nuestros servicios de manera visualmente atractiva, moderna y comercial. El folleto debe transmitir los valores de tecnología, precisión, calidad y confianza que caracterizan a nuestro laboratorio. Se requiere una estética minimalista, elegante y de alto nivel, que se diferencie de los folletos dentales genéricos. Es fundamental incorporar buenas fotografías de trabajos dentales, utilizar espacios en blanco de forma efectiva y lograr una presentación visual premium. Los servicios clave a destacar incluyen: - Carillas y restauraciones en disilicato de litio / IPS e.max - Coronas y puentes en zirconio - Diseño digital de sonrisa - Diseño CAD dental - Impresión 3D - Modelos dentales - Guías quirúrgicas - Provisionales y restauraciones digitales - Flujo de trabajo con escaneo intraoral Además del diseño, se espera que el profesional asesore en la estructura y distribución del contenido, incluyendo secciones como portada, presentación del laboratorio, detalle de servicios, ventajas competitivas, descripción del flujo de trabajo y una clara llamada a la acción. Los entregables solicitados son: - Archivo listo para impresión en alta resolución. - Archivo editable original (por ejemplo, en Adobe InDesign, Illustrator o Photoshop). - Versión digital en formato PDF. Se valorará positivamente la experiencia previa en diseño para el sector odontológico, laboratorios dentales, medicina o para marcas que requieran una imagen premium. Categoría: Diseño y Multimedia Subcategoría: Diseño Editorial Tamaño del proyecto: Medio

opportunities.title: Build a 3D co-op escape game in Unreal Engine 5 for PC (Steam) and PS5 – top-quality graphics and sound
opportunities.description: We are Sewar Al Tamayoz Group (Saudi Arabia). We have a complete, fully documented design for a first-person 3D escape game and want one studio or team to build it in Unreal Engine 5 for PC (Steam) and PlayStation 5, with cross-play. What you will build - 2 buildings, 13 rooms, 39 escape routes (3 per room); solo, online co-op for 2–4 players, and 2-player split screen - 4 stylized cartoon heroes with abilities; guards, searchlights, beasts and shades - A night system: progress carries over, and every random draw re-rolls from a seed - Player accounts, cross-play sessions and a leaderboard (weekly, all-time, daily), verified on the server by replaying each run - Full voice-over in English and Arabic (White Arabic), with a right-to-left Arabic UI - A closed beta with 15–20 teams, the Steam release and PS5 certification The quality we need - Graphics: stylized 3D animation at feature-film quality, matching the key art and 13 room mood images we supply. We provide all concept art; you make all production art from it. - Sound: an original score, and professional native-speaking voice actors in both languages, recorded in a studio and delivered as 48 kHz / 24-bit masters. You must have - Shipped Unreal Engine games: tell us how many games you have developed, with links - A portfolio of stylized 3D work at this level - Online multiplayer experience, and PlayStation development access (PlayStation Partners) or a plan to get it How to bid - This project has an NDA. Sign it to read the attached Studio Brief and Request for Quotation; the full design package goes to shortlisted bidders. - Price every line of the price schedule; the lines must add up to your bid. - Milestone payments: 10% / 15% / 15% / 15% / 15% / 20%, plus a 10% retention paid 90 days after launch. - All IP, AI-generated material included, transfers to us under the IP Agreement. We score proposals on graphics (30%), games developed (20%), price (20%), technical approach (15%), schedule and team (10%) and Arabic capability (5%).

opportunities.title: Automatización IA Calificación de Leads
opportunities.description: Quiero poner en marcha cuanto antes un sistema de prospección outbound inteligente que vaya más allá del simple envío de correos. Mi prioridad es que la IA evalúe cada contacto y asigne una puntuación fiable sobre su probabilidad de compra para que mi equipo solo hable con los leads que realmente importan. Trabajo principalmente con herramientas de outreach y CRM, así que necesito que la solución que propongas pueda integrarse sin fricciones con las plataformas habituales (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Apollo o similares). opportunities.title: n8n AI Content Workflow
opportunities.description: I want a single n8n workflow that ingests our website, marketing-campaign, and social-media performance data, funnels it through two AI agents (Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini), and gives me a ready-to-use social media content plan. Workflow outline • Data collection – pull daily metrics from Google Analytics 4, Meta/Instagram, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, plus our email platform’s campaign stats. • Data preparation – deduplicate, normalise dates and UTM tags, then store the clean set in Postgres (or another lightweight DB you suggest). • AI processing – – Claude analyses the fresh data, surfaces trends, audience interests, and high-engagement topics. – Gemini turns those insights into a weekly calendar: post titles, short copy, suggested visuals, and ideal publish times for each network. • Output – push the content plan to a shared Google Sheet and send a formatted PDF summary to Slack. Acceptance criteria 1. Workflow runs on a schedule and can also be triggered manually. 2. Source APIs, DB connection, and both AI calls are fully parameterised with environment variables. 3. Claude’s analysis and Gemini’s content plan are saved separately and timestamped. 4. Clear README showing how to import, configure, and extend the flow. Please keep the solution entirely inside n8n (no external glue scripts) and use only official or widely adopted community nodes. If anything is unclear, feel free to ask before you start; I’ll respond quickly so we can keep momentum.

opportunities.title: Accelerate Web Scraping Automation
opportunities.description: My current browser-based scraper does everything I need in terms of accuracy, yet it still feels sluggish. I want a specialist to dive into the code, spot the bottlenecks, and refactor or redesign whatever is necessary so the whole run completes significantly faster—from initial launch to the final data export. You’ll be working with an existing setup that controls a headless browser (Selenium and Python right now, though I’m open to Playwright, Puppeteer, or other frameworks if they prove faster). Caching static assets, smarter wait conditions, asynchronous calls, or even switching drivers are all on the table—whatever reduces overall execution time without sacrificing reliability. Deliverables • A refactored script or module ready to drop into my project • A short performance report comparing before-and-after runtimes and explaining the changes made • Clear instructions for any new dependencies or environment tweaks I’ll test the new version against my standard batch of target pages; a successful hand-off is one that completes the scrape at noticeably higher speed while still returning the exact same data set.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40667013, publicado hace 5 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 10 - 30.

opportunities.title: Build Autonomous API-Driven CEO Agent
opportunities.description: I want to delegate routine orchestration work to an AI “CEO” agent that can create, supervise, and report on the activities of other specialized agents without my constant involvement. Initial integration focus • Connect directly to n8n so the agent can read, trigger, and update my existing automations and workflows through the n8n API. • Handle incoming requests, decide which workflow they belong to, and route them accordingly. Core capabilities 1. API mastery – the agent must be structured so additional connectors (Claude for agent creation, Odoo for business data, Meta messaging, etc.) can be plugged in later without re-architecting the whole system. 2. Rule-based decision engine – when a workflow stalls or errors, it should attempt a predefined fix automatically. Only if the fix fails should it raise an alert for human review. 3. Monitoring & reporting – provide a lightweight dashboard or log feed that shows every delegated task’s status, retry attempts, and final outcome. Key deliverables • Working CEO agent running against my n8n instance with documented setup steps. • Configuration file or interface for defining the automatic-fix rules. • Alert mechanism (email, Slack, or webhook—your suggestion welcome) that triggers only after a failed self-repair. • Clear, extensible codebase and instructions on how to add future connectors to Claude, Odoo, and Meta. Acceptance criteria - Agent successfully routes at least three distinct incoming request types to the correct n8n workflows. - Demonstrated automatic fix on a controlled failure, followed by an alert when the fix is ineffective. - Real-time status view or log proving continuous monitoring. I value readable, well-documented code and prefer open-source libraries where practical. Let me know your proposed tech stack and timeline so we can get this CEO agent up and running quickly.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40824760, publicado hace 5 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 30 - 250.

opportunities.title: 2D Exercise Technique Animation
opportunities.description: I need a clean, professional 2D animation that teaches fitness trainers and gym members exactly how to perform one specific exercise. The short clip should: • Show the correct body position and movement from multiple camera angles so form is unmistakable. • Overlay the main muscles being activated—simple color highlights or semi-transparent anatomy layers are fine, as long as they are clear. • Briefly contrast common mistakes (for example, rounding the back or locking the knees) with the proper technique so viewers instantly see the difference. I have reference photos and written cues ready; you supply the storyboard, character design, full 2D rigging, smooth motion animation and synced call-outs. Adobe After Effects, Toon Boom or a comparable rig-based workflow is preferred so I can request tweaks frame-accurately. Final deliverables: 1080p MP4, the editable project file with all rigged assets, and a separate PNG or JPEG set of stills for quick printouts. The piece must stay under two minutes, maintain a clean medical-style aesthetic, and be persuasive enough for classroom screens or social-media reposts. Let me know your usual turnaround for draft, revisions and final render so we can lock a realistic timeline.

opportunities.title: IT Client Acquisition Partner Needed
opportunities.description: Business Development & Client Acquisition Partner for Aevona Solution Project Overview Aevona Solution is a technology solutions company looking for a motivated business development partner who can help us acquire clients for our IT and technology services. Our team handles website development, custom web applications, mobile applications, website redesigns, AI/ML solutions, automation, cloud services, and other technical solutions. We are looking for someone who can focus on finding potential clients, initiating conversations, and bringing genuine business opportunities to our company. Responsibilities - Identify businesses that need websites, web applications, mobile apps, or other IT solutions. - Research potential clients in Indian and international markets. - Generate and qualify genuine business leads. - Conduct personalized cold outreach through email and other permitted channels. - Communicate with prospects and arrange potential project discussions. - Follow up with interested prospects and help convert them into paying clients. Compensation - 20% commission on successfully acquired projects. - No upfront payment required. - Commission calculated on actual payments received from clients. - Payment terms and milestones will be mutually agreed upon and documented through Freelancer.com. Ideal Candidate - Experience in B2B lead generation and client acquisition. - Strong communication and negotiation skills. - Experience finding clients for IT companies, web development agencies, or freelancers. - Ability to independently research prospects and conduct outreach. - Comfortable working on a performance-based commission model. Long-Term Opportunity We are looking to establish a long-term professional relationship with someone who can consistently bring genuine business opportunities. You will focus on finding clients and business development, while our Founder and engineering team will handle technical discussions, project planning, development, and delivery. If you are confident in your ability to acquire clients and build valuable business relationships, we would love to work with you. Skills Required Sales, Market Research, Email Marketing, Lead Generation, B2B Marketing, Business Development, Cold Calling, Client Acquisition, Communication Skills.

opportunities.title: Realistic 3D Scrolling Website
opportunities.description: I’m ready to commission a fully-interactive, 3D-animated website that feels as lifelike as possible while users scroll. The primary purpose is to tell our brand story in a way that instantly builds trust, centering every section around the quality we deliver, the process that gets us there, and the results our clients enjoy. I’d like each scroll action to reveal a seamless WebGL scene—think Three.js or a comparable framework—where textures, lighting, and subtle motion cues make the experience feel tangible, not gimmicky. As visitors progress, the narrative should move from an overview of our craftsmanship to a peek behind the scenes, finishing with proof of the outcomes we achieve. Because there’s no fixed deadline, I’m open to an iterative approach: first a clickable prototype, then polished visuals, and finally full deployment. Mobile responsiveness, fast load times, and clean, documented code are non-negotiable so the site remains future-proof. If this sounds like a challenge you’d enjoy, let’s discuss your concept for bringing our story to life.

opportunities.title: Scale Saree Sales via Instagram
opportunities.description: My saree boutique clears about ₹20 k a month, but I know Instagram ads can push us far beyond that. I need an ads specialist who can take over the full cycle—creative, targeting, setup, optimisation—and keep one clear goal in sight: drive more WhatsApp enquiries that convert into orders. Here’s the flow I have in mind. An ad featuring our daily-wear collections appears in the feed or Stories. When someone taps it, they land on a clean, mobile-friendly page that shows a curated set of saree photos, prices, and a single “Message on WhatsApp” button. That page nudges them to open a chat, so I can handle sizing, fabric questions, and close the sale quickly. I’ll supply product photos, pricing, and any brand guidelines you need. You’ll decide the best audience segments, craft thumb-stopping copy, set up the Meta Ads campaign, and link everything through to WhatsApp Business. Ongoing tweaks based on cost-per-lead and ROAS are essential; I want to scale as soon as campaigns prove profitable. If you’re comfortable with Meta Ads Manager, WhatsApp Click-to-Chat, basic landing-page builders, and reading the data to keep cost per message low, let’s talk about timelines and milestones so we can start moving stock faster.

opportunities.title: Aggiornamento gestionale Assiexpress
opportunities.description: Desidero potenziare il mio programma Assiexpress per la gestione della subagenzia di assicurazioni. L’area prioritaria è la Gestione clienti, polizze e scadenze. Mi occorrono tre migliorie concrete: • Schede clienti e ricerca rapida – voglio anagrafiche complete, filtrabili in pochi secondi. • Inserimento e rinnovo delle polizze – flussi semplificati, con campi pre-compilati e controlli sugli errori. • Avvisi automatici per scadenze e rinnovi – notifiche che partano senza intervento manuale. Gli avvisi dovranno essere inviati Via SMS o WhatsApp; se in futuro servirà anche la notifica interna o via e-mail, sarà utile che il codice resti estendibile. Mi aspetto: 1. Analisi della struttura esistente di Assiexpress. 2. Proposta tecnica con tempistiche e strumenti (librerie SMS/WhatsApp, eventuale API). 3. Implementazione delle tre funzioni sopra elencate. 4. Test e piccole rifiniture fino alla piena operatività. Consegna del codice sorgente ben commentato e di una breve guida d’uso. Puntualità, chiarezza e codice pulito sono fondamentali.

opportunities.title: Beauty E-Commerce Store Build
opportunities.description: Quiero lanzar “El paraíso de Ana” como una tienda en línea especializada en productos de belleza y cuidado personal. El objetivo principal es que cualquier visitante pueda elegir artículos, añadirlos al carrito y completar el pago sin fricciones desde un ordenador o un móvil. Alcance práctico • Diseño y desarrollo de la tienda completa en español, con un look fresco que evoque la idea de paraíso. • Catálogo autogestionable: necesito poder crear, editar o desactivar productos y categorías sin tocar código. • Integración de pasarelas de pago seguras (PayPal, Stripe o una alternativa local que me sugieras) y comprobación de que todo el flujo de compra funcione de principio a fin. • Panel de pedidos para ver estados, generar guías y marcar envíos. • Configuración básica de SEO on-page, velocidad y versión responsive. Entrego textos, logos y fotografías; espero de tu parte la tienda lista para producción y una breve guía de uso para que mi equipo la administre. Más adelante me interesaría añadir cuentas de usuario o valoraciones, por lo que agradeceré que el código quede limpio y escalable. Indícame la tecnología que prefieras (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento o headless con React, por ejemplo) y el tiempo estimado; elegiré la opción que ofrezca el mejor equilibrio entre rendimiento, facilidad de mantenimiento y coste.

opportunities.title: Tekla Detailing for Steel Structure
opportunities.description: We are looking for an experienced Freelance Tekla Structures Detailer to prepare accurate and detailed steel fabrication and shop drawings for industrial, commercial and structural steel projects. Experience Required - Strong experience in steel structural modelling and detailing. - Hands-on experience in preparing fabrication drawings and shop drawings. - Knowledge of steel connections, bolts, welds and fabrication practices. - Experience in industrial buildings, PEB structures and commercial steel structures is preferred. Scope of Work - 3D Steel Structural Modelling using Tekla Structures. - Preparation of General Arrangement (GA) Drawings. - Preparation of Assembly Drawings. - Preparation of Single-Part Drawings. - Preparation of Steel Fabrication Drawings. - Preparation of Erection and Shop Drawings. - Connection Detailing (Bolted and Welded Connections). - Preparation of Anchor Bolt and Base Plate Details. - Preparation of Material Take-Off (MTO) and Bill of Materials (BOM). - Preparation of CNC / DSTV files, where required. Required Skills - Excellent working knowledge of Tekla Structures. - Ability to interpret structural design and engineering drawings. - Good understanding of steel fabrication and erection procedures. - Knowledge of structural steel sections, connections, bolts and welding details. - Ability to produce fabrication-ready drawings with accuracy. - Ability to coordinate and work under the guidance of a Structural Engineer. - Good communication and timely project delivery. We are looking for technically skilled and detail-oriented Tekla professionals who can deliver accurate, fabrication-ready steel detailing drawings.

opportunities.description: I have a spreadsheet that contains nothing more than each prospect’s name and email address. I need an end-to-end solution that will take that file, send a personalized email to every contact, copy the messages to my own inbox, and then quietly monitor two things: • whether the recipient opens the email • whether the recipient clicks the link that points to our website No follow-ups, auto-replies, or extra sequences are required—accurate tracking of opens and link clicks is all I’m after. If you can build an AI-powered agent or lightweight script that handles the sending cycle automatically, even better. I’d like a simple way to upload fresh spreadsheets whenever I have new leads, hit “send,” and later review a clean report that shows open and click data for each address. Please describe the approach you would take, the tech stack or email-automation platform you prefer, and the output format you’ll provide for the tracking results. Feel free to suggest any safeguards for deliverability, throttling, or domain authentication that will help keep our messages out of spam.

I need an end-to-end solution that will take that file, send a personalized email to every contact, copy the messages to my own inbox, and then quietly monitor two things: • whether the recipient opens the email • whether the recipient clicks the link that points to our website No follow-ups, auto-replies, or extra sequences are required—accurate tracking of opens and link clicks is all I’m after. If you can build an AI-powered agent or lightweight script that handles the sending cycle automatically, even better. I’d like a simple way to upload fresh spreadsheets whenever I have new leads, hit “send,” and later review a clean report that shows open and click data for each address. Please describe the approach you would take, the tech stack or email-automation platform you prefer, and the output format you’ll provide for the tracking results. Feel free to suggest any safeguards for deliverability, throttling, or domain authentication that will help keep our messages out of spam."

opportunities.title: 3ds Max LED Exhibition Booth Design
opportunities.description: 3ds Max Designer: 3×3 m Exhibition Booth, Blue Digital/LED Finish, Renders + Technical Drawings (12h) We need an experienced 3ds Max designer to model a standard 3×3 m exhibitor booth Deadline: 12 hours from award. Design reference: the attached image shows the design intent. Your model must follow it closely: the blue digital fascia band with exhibitor name, the brushed-aluminium portal columns with angled top beams, the backlit blue ribbed back walls, the dark counters, and the blue LED lines on the fascia, columns and platform edge. Finish: Blue / Digital. Wood structure, flexible LED surfaces on the façades, blue perforated steel, blue plaster/paint, black grid ceiling, LED strip lighting, carpet. Scope, confirmed in advance: Layout: 5 booths of 3×3 m in a row, 15 m long in total, sharing the overhead structure Height: the total height is 3.0 m maximum, measured from the hall floor and including the platform, fascia, towers and beams. Nothing may go above 3.0 m. Scale the reference proportions down to fit, and make the heights easy to change in the model. Fascia: model it as a flexible LED surface, as a separate object with exact dimensions. The LED is supplied by a separate AV vendor, so also show its fixing frame, ventilation gap and power and data routes. Columns and beams: brushed aluminium, as in the image Logos: placeholders only. Write “EXHIBITOR LOGO” on the fascia and reception table, and use an “EVENT LOGO” block on the row ends and tower. Furniture: 2 stools and 2 ottomans per booth, replacing the armchairs and side table in the image Drawings: buildable and dimensioned (materials, thicknesses, panel sizes, joinery and fixing details, electrical layout). We do not need full shop drawings or cutting lists. Booth specification: Raised platform, 8–10 cm, plywood with melamine, cove light and skirting Back wall and side dividers with concealed linear lighting Reinforced wall for a 55" horizontal TV, with concealed conduit and power outlet 1 display counter, 1 reception table with printed exhibitor logo 1 power socket strip, all cabling concealed Renders required (8 × 4K, photoreal, V-Ray or Corona): Front perspective, eye level 3/4 view from the left 3/4 view from the right Full row view: all 5 booths with the shared structure and row-end logo Top/bird’s-eye view Close-up of the reception table and counter Close-up of the blue perforated steel and LED fascia Night/lighting-mode view with the LED active Technical drawings (DWG + PDF, dimensioned, A3 with title block): floor plan with furniture, front and side elevations, 2 sections, overhead structure details, platform/cove/skirting detail, LED fascia frame and perforated steel fixing details, counter and reception table joinery, electrical layout including LED power, graphics layout, material schedule. Deliverables: 3ds Max file (2021 or later), archived with textures and lights; renders in JPG/PNG; drawings in DWG and PDF. All files become our client’s property. To bid: 2–3 booth projects in 3ds Max, your render engine, confirmation that you can deliver in 24h, and a fixed price. Skills: 3ds Max, V-Ray, Corona, AutoCAD, Exhibition Design, 3D Rendering

opportunities.title: Urgent 3D Character Modeling
opportunities.description: I need a single, fully-detailed 3D character (or creature) model completed as soon as possible. The mesh should be clean, UV-unwrapped, and supplied in a widely-used format such as FBX or OBJ, along with the native project files from whichever tool you prefer—Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Houdini, etc. Send a concise but thorough project proposal that explains your workflow, estimated turnaround, and any steps you take to guarantee proper topology and scale. Please anchor that proposal with links to a few comparable characters you have built so I can gauge fit quickly. Deliverables • High-poly sculpt and a game-ready low-poly version • UVs laid out logically and without overlap • Final files in FBX/OBJ plus native scene files • One or two quick beauty renders or viewport captures for verification I will review submissions as they arrive and award the project immediately once I see a solid plan that meets the timeline.

opportunities.title: Detect Hidden Scroll Content
opportunities.description: Title: Browser layout expert: detect content hidden in scroll regions (5 h, hourly) About the project A test harness that renders React components in headless Chromium (TypeScript, Vite, Playwright), changes their content and screen size, and measures whether the layout breaks. Breakage is found by geometry, not by comparing screenshots: five checks run inside the page and report overflow, clipping, content spilling out of its box, overlap and content cut off by the screen edge. The checks have been compared against blind human labels. The problem The checks treat every scroll container as fine, because content past its edge can be reached by scrolling. Human labellers disagree in one kind of case: a navigation row that scrolls with its scroll bar hidden by CSS, and at 200% text size shrinks until only "Dashb" of its first link shows. The screenshots show no scroll bars at all, so the rule has to come from the page's DOM and CSS, not from the picture. The current checks are frozen, so this is a prototype rule for the next version. What you'll do Must have: 1. Define, in plain words first, and then implement a new check for scroll regions that hide content without any sign that they scroll: either the scroll bar is hidden by CSS, or the visible area has shrunk smaller than a single item. 2. Put the check behind a switch, so that with the switch off nothing in the current results changes. 3. Pin its behaviour with lab cases (minimal HTML with exact expected counts, both cases it must flag and cases it must not): left-to-right and right-to-left pages, horizontal and vertical scrolling, nested scroll containers, scroll bars hidden in each common way, and regions that are cut off but do show that they scroll. If time is left: 4. Content pushed past a scroll container's start edge (for example centred content wider than its container), which cannot be scrolled to at all. 5. A badge or pill that runs under neighbouring text that sits in no box. Acceptance (I will run these) - Switch off: the full test suite passes, and no existing check's output changes. - Switch on: - your lab cases pass; - none of the 20 hand-written reference components gets a finding in any of the 19 test cases; - the real component from the disagreement above fails its case; - three real cases whose scroll region is already cut in the unchanged render get no new failure. - Checks stay plain DOM functions: no timers, no randomness, no network. Deliverables - Commits in the repository I give you (Conventional Commits format, no trailers), sent back as patch files. You don't push anywhere. - A one-page report: the rule in plain words, what it catches and what it misses, the acceptance results, open questions and time spent. Terms Hourly at 35$, capped at 5 hours. Must-haves first; if you reach the cap, stop and report where you are. Node 26; scripts must work on Windows, macOS and Linux. To apply, answer briefly 1. Screenshots in this harness show no scroll bars. From inside the page, how would you tell whether a scroll container's scroll bar is hidden by CSS, both with `scrollbar-width: none` and with a `::-webkit-scrollbar` rule? 2. An `overflow-x: auto` container holds a flex row with `justify-content: center` that is wider than the container. What can the user scroll to, and what can't they?

Design reference: the attached image shows the design intent. Your model must follow it closely: the vertical wooden-slat fascia band with exhibitor name, the light-wood portal columns with angled top beams and integrated LED lines, the warm wood-slat back walls, and the lit platform edge. Finish: Natural / Green. Laminate wood, wooden slats and acoustic strips, green backlit polycarbonate and green acrylic, sandy plaster texture, greenery, carpet. The reference image shows mostly wood. Please add the green backlit polycarbonate/acrylic accents from the material spec, for example on a side divider or the counter front. Booth specification: Raised platform, 8–10 cm, plywood with melamine, cove light and skirting Back wall and side dividers with concealed linear lighting Reinforced wall for a 55" horizontal TV, with concealed conduit and power outlet 1 display counter, 1 reception table with printed exhibitor logo 2 stools and 2 ottomans (these replace the armchairs and side table shown in the reference) Fascia with exhibitor name/logo; event logo on row ends Shared overhead tower with lightbox and 3D cut-out logo 1 power socket strip, all cabling concealed Renders required (8 × 4K, photoreal, V-Ray or Corona): Front perspective, eye level 3/4 view from the left 3/4 view from the right Row view: 3–4 booths with the shared tower and row-end logo Top/bird’s-eye view Close-up of the reception table and counter Close-up of the slat wall and green backlit panels Night/lighting-mode view Technical drawings (DWG + PDF, dimensioned, A3 with title block): floor plan with furniture, front and side elevations, 2 sections, overhead tower details, platform/cove/skirting detail, slat wall and backlit panel details, counter and reception table joinery, electrical layout, graphics/fascia layout, material schedule. opportunities.title: WooCommerce MVP for Physical and Software Products(e.x. : 3D models)
opportunities.description: I need an experienced WooCommerce developer to build the MVP of an online store that sells two kinds of products: 1) Physical products from everyday categories (home, fashion, electronics, beauty, sports, etc.) 2) Digital assets: 3D models (3ds Max, Blender, FBX/OBJ), textures and similar files, downloaded after payment. The finished site must be LIVE online, and all code must be in my GitHub repository. IMPORTANT - ZERO COST: this is an MVP and I will not buy anything. No paid domain, hosting, theme, plugin or PayPal account. Use free hosting with a free subdomain, free themes/plugins, and the free PayPal Sandbox API. SCOPE (MVP) 1. Setup - WordPress + WooCommerce on free hosting with a free subdomain, HTTPS (free SSL) - All accounts (hosting, GitHub, PayPal Developer) owned by me - Lightweight free theme (Astra, Kadence, Storefront or similar) + child theme, fully mobile responsive 2. Store structure - Pages: Home, Shop, Category, Product, Cart, Checkout, My Account, About, Contact, Privacy, Terms, Refund Policy - Categories for physical goods + a "Digital Assets" section (3D Models > 3ds Max / Blender / FBX-OBJ, Textures, Scripts/Plugins) - Product search and filters (category, price; file format/software for digital items) 3. Physical products - Simple and variable products (size, color), stock management, flat-rate shipping 4. Digital products - Virtual + downloadable products with preview image gallery - Attributes: file format, software version, poly count - License options as variations (Personal / Commercial) with different prices - Secure download links in the order email and My Account, with download limit/expiry - If the host limits upload size, propose a free solution for large files (e.g. free cloud storage) - Mixed cart (physical + digital): shipping charged only for physical items 5. Payments - PayPal - Official WooCommerce PayPal Payments plugin (PayPal REST API) - Free PayPal Sandbox only: the MVP runs in test mode, no live PayPal account - Going live later must only need live API keys entered, no code changes - Order emails to customer and admin (free SMTP service if the host blocks email) 6. Basics - SEO plugin (Rank Math or Yoast) + sitemap - Caching, image optimization, login protection, backups - 10 sample physical + 5 sample digital products (I provide content, or placeholders) 7. GitHub - Repo in my GitHub account, commits every day (not one upload at the end) - Child theme, custom code, plugin list, database export, README with setup steps - No passwords or API keys in the repo 8. Handover - Admin access + short screen recording (10-15 min): adding physical and digital products, managing orders ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA - Site is live on the free subdomain over HTTPS, works on mobile and desktop - Sandbox purchase of a physical product creates an order with shipping - Sandbox purchase of a digital product gives a working download link right after payment - Mixed cart order works correctly - GitHub repo is complete; the README lets another developer set up the site - Running cost to me is $0 (nothing purchased) NOT IN SCOPE (possible Phase 2) Custom domain, paid hosting, live PayPal payments, multi-vendor marketplace, 3D model viewer, other payment gateways, logo/branding, mobile app. Shopify experience is a plus for future work, but this build is WooCommerce. BUDGET AND TIMELINE - Fixed price, $250-750 USD - 4-5 days from award - Milestones: 30% after setup, theme and structure (day 2); 40% after products, downloads and PayPal sandbox (day 4); 30% after live deployment, GitHub and handover (day 5) IN YOUR BID, PLEASE INCLUDE - Start your bid with the word "3D-READY" so I know you read this - Links to 2-3 live WooCommerce stores you built (digital download stores are a big plus) - Which free hosting and subdomain you will use, and confirm PayPal Sandbox payments and webhooks work on it - Your day-by-day plan to finish in 5 days Generic copy-paste bids will be ignored.

Store structure - Pages: Home, Shop, Category, Product, Cart, Checkout, My Account, About, Contact, Privacy, Terms, Refund Policy - Categories for physical goods + a "Digital Assets" section (3D Models > 3ds Max / Blender / FBX-OBJ, Textures, Scripts/Plugins) - Product search and filters (category, price; file format/software for digital items) 3. Physical products - Simple and variable products (size, color), stock management, flat-rate shipping 4. Digital products - Virtual + downloadable products with preview image gallery - Attributes: file format, software version, poly count - License options as variations (Personal / Commercial) with different prices - Secure download links in the order email and My Account, with download limit/expiry - If the host limits upload size, propose a free solution for large files (e.g. free cloud storage) - Mixed cart (physical + digital): shipping charged only for physical items 5. Payments - PayPal - Official WooCommerce PayPal Payments plugin (PayPal REST API) - Free PayPal Sandbox only: the MVP runs in test mode, no live PayPal account - Going live later must only need live API keys entered, no code changes - Order emails to customer and admin (free SMTP service if the host blocks email) 6. Basics - SEO plugin (Rank Math or Yoast) + sitemap - Caching, image optimization, login protection, backups - 10 sample physical + 5 sample digital products (I provide content, or placeholders) 7. GitHub - Repo in my GitHub account, commits every day (not one upload at the end) - Child theme, custom code, plugin list, database export, README with setup steps - No passwords or API keys in the repo 8. Handover - Admin access + short screen recording (10-15 min): adding physical and digital products, managing orders ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA - Site is live on the free subdomain over HTTPS, works on mobile and desktop - Sandbox purchase of a physical product creates an order with shipping - Sandbox purchase of a digital product gives a working download link right after payment - Mixed cart order works correctly - GitHub repo is complete; the README lets another developer set up the site - Running cost to me is $0 (nothing purchased) NOT IN SCOPE (possible Phase 2) Custom domain, paid hosting, live PayPal payments, multi-vendor marketplace, 3D model viewer, other payment gateways, logo/branding, mobile app. Shopify experience is a plus for future work, but this build is WooCommerce. BUDGET AND TIMELINE - Fixed price, $250-750 USD - 4-5 days from award - Milestones: 30% after setup, theme and structure (day 2); 40% after products, downloads and PayPal sandbox (day 4); 30% after live deployment, GitHub and handover (day 5) IN YOUR BID, PLEASE INCLUDE - Start your bid with the word "3D-READY" so I know you read this - Links to 2-3 live WooCommerce stores you built (digital download stores are a big plus) - Which free hosting and subdomain you will use, and confirm PayPal Sandbox payments and webhooks work on it - Your day-by-day plan to finish in 5 days Generic copy-paste bids will be ignored."

opportunities.title: Ongoing Blender 3D Asset Creation
opportunities.description: I’m looking to partner with a skilled 3D artist who works comfortably and efficiently in Blender. This will be a long-term collaboration with a steady flow of assignments. The exact subject matter will shift from project to project—sometimes a photorealistic product, other times an environment or a short animated sequence—so versatility inside Blender is important. For each brief, I’ll provide references, dimensions, and visual targets. You’ll translate those into polished assets and, when needed, presentation-ready renders. Clean topology, logically named objects, organized node setups, and non-destructive workflows are key, as the files may be handed to other team members down the line. Deliverables for each milestone will be: • The native .blend file with packed textures • High-resolution stills or the final animation, as specified • All baked maps (if applicable) We’ll begin with a small paid test. If that goes smoothly, I’ll queue up a regular cadence of work so we can both plan ahead. Clear, prompt communication and the ability to iterate quickly on feedback will keep the pipeline moving.

opportunities.title: OpenAI n8n Content Workflow
opportunities.description: I’m ready to turn the articles, product pages, and FAQs already living on my website into fresh, AI-generated social captions and longer blog pieces—without touching a keyboard each time. I’m using OpenAI for the writing muscle and want the entire flow orchestrated inside n8n (or Make, if you see an edge there) so the process runs on autopilot. Here’s the vision: a trigger—say, when I publish or update a page—feeds the page URL into the workflow. The automation pulls the text, sends concise briefs or key points to OpenAI, then returns polished social posts and a draft blog article. Finally, the outputs land back in my CMS or a Google Doc, ready for a quick review and publish. Deliverables • A working n8n/Make scenario that scrapes content from my site, prompts OpenAI, and pushes the results to the chosen destination. • Clear, commented prompts so I can tweak tone and length later. • Setup documentation and a quick Loom walkthrough showing the flow in action. Acceptance If I can trigger the scenario with a single page URL and receive one social caption plus a 300-600-word article in under five minutes—no errors, no manual steps—the job is done. Let me know if any additional hooks or API keys are required on my end; I’ll provide them promptly so we can move fast.

opportunities.title: Drive CS2 Deposits via Meta
opportunities.description: I run a Counter-Strike 2 case-opening platform and I’m ready to scale our user base in Europe through Facebook and Instagram. The single KPI that matters to me is the number of first-time deposits generated at an efficient cost. Your job is to design, launch, and continually optimise Meta campaigns that persuade new players to deposit for the first time. Expect full access to our assets, pixel, and event data so you can build granular audiences, craft high-impact creatives, and iterate fast with split tests. Brand awareness is welcome as a by-product, but deposits must always drive your decisions. We already know the strongest offers and have a clear value proposition; what we need is a performance marketer who can translate that into scalable European ad spend while keeping CPA and ROAS targets front-of-mind. Experience with gaming, gambling, or fintech funnels is a plus because of compliance nuances and the importance of friction-free onboarding flows. Deliverables I’ll review each week: • A structured campaign and ad-set architecture tailored to key European markets, complete with detailed targeting and bid strategies • Fresh creative angles (static, video, UGC) backed by data from ongoing tests • A concise report highlighting spend, deposits, cost per first-time deposit, and next steps for optimisation Ideal tools in your workflow include Meta Ads Manager, Google Tag Manager, and any preferred analytics or automation suites. If you can consistently hit or beat the target cost per first-time deposit, we’ll keep scaling and extend the engagement.

opportunities.title: Diseño Redes Sociales Multiplataforma
opportunities.description: Busco apoyo creativo para refrescar la presencia de mi marca en Instagram, Facebook, TikTok y LinkedIn. Necesito piezas visuales coherentes entre sí que mantengan la identidad de marca y se adapten a los formatos de cada plataforma. Alcance del encargo • Publicaciones para el feed: diseños cuadrados y verticales listos para programar, con espacio para copy. • Anuncios promocionales: artes pensadas para campañas pagadas en las mismas redes, optimizadas para alto CTR y con llamados a la acción claros. Qué espero recibir – Propuestas de estilo basadas en mi guía de marca (colores, tipografías y tono). – Archivos finales en PNG/JPG y versiones editables (PSD o AI). – Mockups o vistas previas que muestren cómo se verán dentro de cada plataforma. – Una breve guía de uso para que mi equipo pueda reaprovechar los elementos. Valoraré experiencia previa diseñando para social ads, dominio de herramientas como Photoshop, Illustrator o Figma y conocimiento de las mejores prácticas de cada red social. Indica en tu propuesta plazos estimados y ejemplos de trabajos similares.

opportunities.title: Contenido Integral para Meta Ads VIDEO y CRATIVIDAD ESTATICA
opportunities.description: Desde la actualización de ANDROMEDA en Meta ads, constantemente las campañas nos reclaman cambiar anuncios y añadir nuevas creatividades, nuevos vídeos, etc... Necesito piezas creativas que impulsen la captación de leads en mis campañas de Facebook e Instagram. Busco a una persona o equipo que se ocupe de principio a fin de la creación de: • Imágenes atractivas (estáticas o en carrusel) optimizadas para los formatos de Meta. • Videos cortos – máx. 30 segundos – para los formatos de las campañas de captación de leads. El equipo se debe encargar de: -Una modelo que sea la imagen del vídeo. -Grabar el contenido que le indiquemos según nuestros guiones. -Enviarnos los videos editados listos para que lancemos las campañas publicitarias. Precio por pack de 5 videos y 10 videos. Precio por pack de 4 imágenes y 10 imágenes. Valoraré experiencia previa en campañas de generación de leads, conocimiento de las políticas de anuncios de Meta y capacidad para iterar rápidamente según métricas. Si tienes casos de éxito, compártelos.

opportunities.description: Necesito transformar el contenido de mi próxima ponencia en una presentación de PowerPoint clara, dinámica y visualmente atractiva. La charla se imparte ante una asociación de escuelas de negocio y gira en torno a un tema de Educación o formación; al finalizar, busco que los asistentes puedan aplicar técnicas y herramientas concretas en su propio trabajo. Qué requiero: • Estructurar el mensaje en una secuencia lógica de diapositivas (introducción, desarrollo, casos prácticos, resumen y llamada a la acción). • Incluir recursos visuales: iconos, gráficos sencillos y ejemplos ilustrativos que hagan el contenido fácil de asimilar. • Diseñar un estilo coherente (tipografías legibles, paleta de colores profesional y plantilla unificada). • Añadir animaciones o transiciones sutiles que refuercen la explicación sin distraer. • Entregar archivo editable (.pptx) listo para proyectar y, de ser posible, una versión PDF para respaldo. Proporcionaré el guion y los puntos clave; necesito tu apoyo para convertirlos en diapositivas efectivas que inspiren acción. Si tienes experiencia diseñando presentaciones educativas y sabes cómo convertir conceptos en material práctico, me encantará conocer tu propuesta y ver ejemplos de trabajos previos.

opportunities.title: Optimizar Informes en HubSpot
opportunities.description: Necesito dejar HubSpot listo para que mi equipo y yo podamos medir con precisión todo el rendimiento comercial, desde que un lead entra hasta que se cierra la venta. Hoy los datos están dispersos entre HubSpot, varias hojas de cálculo y otras herramientas, lo que impide ver el panorama completo. Busco a alguien que: • Consolide la información existente y defina los campos necesarios para que cada etapa del embudo quede registrada de forma consistente. • Configure paneles y reportes que muestren ventas cerradas, ingresos, metas, origen y avance de los leads, así como la actividad del equipo (llamadas, correos, reuniones). • Establezca filtros y visualizaciones que faciliten el seguimiento diario y las revisiones mensuales. • Documente los pasos clave para que podamos mantener y ajustar los reportes internamente en el futuro. Si ya has creado dashboards completos en HubSpot CRM y entiendes cómo integrar datos externos, me interesa tu propuesta y ejemplos de trabajos similares.

opportunities.title: Capacitación Masiva en WooCommerce
opportunities.description: Necesito que un especialista en WordPress me enseñe, en español, a realizar cargas y descargas masivas de productos con el plugin WP All Import / WP All Export. Al finalizar la sesión en vivo (compartiendo pantalla) debo ser capaz de: • Importar y exportar correctamente los siguientes datos: – Datos básicos: nombre, precio, descripción e imágenes – Inventario, SKU, categorías y atributos (talla, color, etc.) – Variaciones, precios especiales y datos de envío • Preparar y depurar archivos CSV para cada escenario. • Configurar plantillas y mapeos dentro del plugin para reutilizarlos. • Evitar errores comunes de formato y duplicados. • Automatizar, cuando sea posible, futuras actualizaciones masivas. La capacitación puede ser por Zoom, Meet o la herramienta que prefieras, siempre en horario de América Latina. Busco un enfoque práctico: trabajarás sobre mi sitio de pruebas, me guiarás paso a paso y responderás preguntas en tiempo real. Si dominas WP All Import / Export y tienes experiencia demostrable con WooCommerce, me interesa tu propuesta. Indica cuántas horas estimas para cubrir los temas y cuándo podrías agendar la primera sesión.
